signature: ET DOS Netgear DG632 Web Management Denial Of Service Attempt
rationale: Malformed web-management request crashes a single Netgear device's admin service, i.e. endpoint denial of service against one host rather than a network flood.

signature: ET POLICY Executable and linking format (ELF) file download Over HTTP
rationale: A Linux ELF binary is transferred to a host over plain HTTP, which is the observable of pulling an executable payload onto a victim.

signature: ET CURRENT_EVENTS Unknown Malicious Second Stage Download URI Struct Sept 15 2015
rationale: URI structure characteristic of a compromised host fetching a second-stage payload, i.e. bringing a further binary into the environment.

signature: ET EXPLOIT Possible CVE-2014-3704 Drupal SQLi attempt URLENCODE 1
rationale: SQL injection against the Drupal HTTP service (CVE-2014-3704) is exploitation of a publicly reachable web application.

signature: ET WEB_SERVER Likely Malicious Request for /proc/self/environ
rationale: Request for /proc/self/environ is a local-file-inclusion probe against a listening web server, the same server-side web-app exploitation call used for path traversal.

signature: ET SCAN Behavioral Unusual Port 1434 traffic Potential Scan or Infection
rationale: Unsolicited traffic to MS SQL Monitor UDP/1434 across hosts is probing for a specific listening service, i.e. network service discovery.

signature: ET WEB_SERVER Possible CVE-2014-6271 Attempt in Headers
rationale: Shellshock (CVE-2014-6271) delivered in HTTP headers to a server-side CGI handler is server-side exploitation of a public-facing app, not client-side T1203.

signature: ET POLICY User-Agent (NSIS_Inetc (Mozilla)) - Sometimes used by hostile installers
rationale: The NSIS Inetc downloader user-agent is used by both legitimate and hostile installers, and the title alone cannot say whether an actual malicious payload fetch occurred.

signature: ET TROJAN Possible NanoCore C2 60B
rationale: Fixed-size 60-byte binary beacon over raw TCP on high ports to a NanoCore controller is command and control carried over a non-application-layer protocol.

signature: ET POLICY Executable served from Amazon S3
rationale: A Windows PE executable is served over HTTP from Amazon S3 to an internal host, i.e. an executable payload being pulled in from external hosting.

signature: ET ATTACK_RESPONSE Possible /etc/passwd via HTTP (linux style)
rationale: Contents of /etc/passwd returned in an HTTP response is retrieval of the Unix password file, per the convention's /etc/passwd call.

signature: ET DOS DNS Amplification Attack Possible Outbound Windows Non-Recursive Root Hint Reserved Port
rationale: Spoofed non-recursive DNS root-hint queries used to generate amplified reply volume against a third party is reflection/amplification denial of service.

signature: ET EXPLOIT Possible Palo Alto SSL VPN sslmgr Format String Vulnerability (Inbound)
rationale: Format-string attack against the Palo Alto SSL VPN sslmgr daemon exploits a remotely listening network service exposed to the internet.

signature: ET EXPLOIT Possible iOS Pegasus Safari Exploit (CVE-2016-4657)
rationale: CVE-2016-4657 is a WebKit memory-corruption bug triggered by attacker content parsed in Safari, i.e. client-side exploitation for execution.

signature: ET WEB_SERVER Possible CVE-2015-1427 Elastic Search Sandbox Escape Remote Code Execution Attempt
rationale: Groovy sandbox escape yielding remote code execution on an Elasticsearch service listening over HTTP is exploitation of a public-facing application.

signature: ET DOS Possible NTP DDoS Inbound Frequent Un-Authed MON_LIST Requests IMPL 0x02
rationale: Repeated unauthenticated NTP MON_LIST requests are the classic reflection/amplification vector used to flood a target with amplified responses.

signature: ET SCAN LibSSH Based Frequent SSH Connections Likely BruteForce Attack
rationale: Rapid repeated SSH connection attempts from a libssh client indicate password guessing against the SSH service.

signature: ET WEB_SERVER PHP Possible file Remote File Inclusion Attempt
rationale: PHP remote file inclusion attempt against a web server causes the server-side application to fetch and execute attacker-controlled code.

signature: ET WEB_CLIENT Hex Obfuscation of charCodeAt % Encoding
rationale: Hex/percent-encoded charCodeAt in content served to a browser is script obfuscation intended to hide the payload from inspection.

signature: ET TOR Known Tor Relay/Router (Not Exit) Node Traffic group 615
rationale: Traffic to a known non-exit Tor relay indicates the connection is being routed through a multi-hop anonymising proxy network.

signature: ET SCAN Behavioral Unusual Port 1433 traffic Potential Scan or Infection
rationale: Unsolicited traffic to MS SQL TCP/1433 across hosts is probing for a specific listening service, i.e. network service discovery.

signature: ET SNMP Attempted UDP Access Attempt to Cisco IOS 12.1 Hidden Read/Write Community String ILMI
rationale: Use of the undocumented ILMI read/write SNMP community string is authentication to a Cisco device with a built-in default credential.

signature: ET DOS FreeBSD NFS RPC Kernel Panic
rationale: Malformed NFS RPC input panics the FreeBSD kernel of one target host, i.e. endpoint denial of service rather than a bandwidth flood.

signature: ET WEB_SERVER WEB-PHP phpinfo access
rationale: Requesting phpinfo pages probes a specific web application for exposed configuration and version weaknesses, i.e. active vulnerability scanning.

signature: ET SCAN Suspicious User-Agent - get-minimal - Possible Vuln Scan
rationale: The get-minimal user-agent belongs to an automated web vulnerability scanner sweeping the target's HTTP service.
